title: About Frist Studios
text:
Frist Studios is a small project & company based in the beautiful city of Prague.

We are specializing in Unity (game) development.
We are always looking for new opportunities and challenges and are open to your projects.
We are currently working on
1) Fortress Guardian - a 3D tower defense game which most of this page is dedicated to
2) Sunken Hook - a small open-world isometric game about fishing for a school game development class
3) Accelerus 2 - The continuation of the project Accelerus which was originally made for SSPS Game Jam
4) Smaller private projects in the sector of augmented & virtual reality

We have also worked on a virtual reality project for the Motol University Hospital in Prague, Czech Republic that is actively used in their ENT clinic as a post-surgery rehab tool
If you have any questions or would like to work with us, feel free to
